rules.join: Lipi metadata cisi, whitespace-normalized, base number (prefix and digits without leading zeros) equals the printed CISI number; one family per number, one number per family.
rules.before: Lipi usable excavation-idno; older-export MUSEUM for the same raw CISI key (museum number and institution); Lipi area-section, block-house or room-grid (findspot); depth; material; positive millimetre dimensions; usable as in the data inventory.
rules.after: before, or a usable value in the CISI 2 row: printed excavation number (not ???), a museum code with a number or NMP accession, a museum code, a four-digit FC number. CISI 2 prints no findspot, depth, material or dimension column.
rules.excavation_comparison: exact: equal after removing spaces, hyphens, slashes, dots, commas and case; lipi-adds-fc-tail: the Lipi string is the printed number followed by the FC number without its first digit (with or without leading zeros); area-prefix-differs: the same after removing the leading letters of both; lipi-incomplete: the Lipi string lacks the area letters or the number; matches-another-entry: the Lipi string equals another entry's printed number plus FC tail; cisi-fc-uncertain: the FC cell is bracketed and no rule above applies; same-number-tail-differs: the Lipi string starts with the printed number but the appended digits differ from the FC tail; number-differs-tail-agrees: the appended digits match the FC tail but the number differs; different: none of these; cisi-cell-uncertain: the printed excavation cell has a bracketed character.
rules.museum_comparison: agree: an older-export (code, number) pair equals a CISI 2 pair after mapping MJD to MD, LHR to L, NMK to NMP and removing dots and P- prefixes; same-number-different-code; different; cisi-cell-uncertain.
